title: The Mosaic Covenant I: Exodus
subtitle: Exodus 1-24
theme: God redeems before he commands. The pattern of grace establishing law.
memoryText: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
reviewQuestions: Why does it matter that God redeems Israel before giving them the law at Sinai?
What does the Passover reveal about the nature of atonement?
What are the three uses of the law, and can you find each one in Exodus?
How does the Exodus function as a pattern for all of God’s saving work?
psalmsNote: Psalms 106, 77, 114, and 105:26-45 retell the exodus as worship.
